title: Prison-guards' one-day stoppage over two missing union members
reason: A work stoppage is reported, but no public march or gathering is described; a planned press conference was canceled. The available reporting therefore does not establish the codebook's public-gathering threshold.
notes: Studio Tamani says it began and was suspended on 29 Oct after authorities gave guarantees concerning two missing members. Bamada's separate suspension report also provides no gathering or turnout. General civil-rights claims are not coded as event response.
